name: Mentions
description: Push ntfy alerts when someone @-mentions a project member in a comment. Team topic gets every mention; Notify me only fires for you.
author: SentientTD Studios

settings.label: Topic URL
settings.description: HTTPS topic URL such as https://ntfy.sh/my-mentions. Private/LAN hosts are rejected.

settings.label: Access token (optional)
settings.description: Bearer token if the ntfy topic requires authentication.

settings.label: Triggers
settings.description: Leave enabled to post @-mentions. Blank the message template to skip.

settings.label: Skip mentions I wrote
settings.description: On Notify me, do not push when you mentioned yourself.
